name: Tobias
source:
Tobias was brought to the orphanage four years ago, after his mother went missing. He's eight now, and best friends with Miah. They keep each other company and get up to trouble together.

Raen has always found it a little strange. How could someone go missing here? He's never asked any questions about it, though.
